info.name: ArchViz Launcher API
info.description:
Tests for the launcher's HTTP API (launcher-server.js and bridge/).

Pick an environment first: **ArchViz Launcher · local** (a launcher on this PC) or **ArchViz Launcher · live** (api.g-741studio.com).
Folders 1 to 6 only read, or send requests the server refuses, so they are safe against the live launcher.
Folders 7 to 12 create test data and delete it again. They run only when the environment sets `allowWrites` to `true`, which only the local environment does.

Setup steps: postman/README.md in the archviz-launcher-infra repository.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get('baseUrl')) throw new Error('No environment selected: pick "ArchViz Launcher · local" or "· live" at the top right.');
// Every response: answered in time, and an /api/ answer carries the CORS header the website's pages need.
